description.en: The solstitial group in Ashmand 1822. Tropical here names this group, not the whole tropical zodiac. Membership is defined by astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group.

description.en: The equinoctial group in Ashmand 1822. The source's equal-day/night rationale is historical, not an observed daylight guarantee. Membership is defined by astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group.
description.zh: Ashmand 1822 年版的分点分组。原文的昼夜等长理由是历史说法，不保证实际日照时长。成员由 astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group 定义。

description.en: The group immediately following the tropical and equinoctial signs in zodiac order in Ashmand 1822. The expanded membership is derived from that ordering, not a verbatim list. Membership is defined by astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group.
description.zh: Ashmand 1822 年版中在黄道次序里紧接至点星座与分点星座的分组。完整名单按这一次序展开，不是原文逐项列举。成员由 astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group 定义。

description.en: The group immediately following the fixed signs in zodiac order in Ashmand 1822. The expanded membership is derived from that ordering. The label supplies no temperament score or interpretation. Membership is defined by astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group.
description.zh: Ashmand 1822 年版中在黄道次序里紧接固定星座的分组，完整名单按这一次序展开。组名不提供性质评分或解读。成员由 astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group 定义。

name.en: Lilly 1647 seven-planet rulership and four statuses
name.zh: Lilly 1647 年版七政守护及四状态

definition.en: astrology.dignities owns the seven-planet domicile and sign-wide exaltation assignments. Detriment is opposite a domicile and fall opposite exaltation. essential_dignities returns all matches in domicile, exaltation, detriment, fall order; an empty tuple means none of these four. HouseRulers applies sign_ruler to each supplied cusp sign and retains existing ruler placements without recalculation; this composition policy is project-authored.
definition.zh: astrology.dignities 定义七政入庙及覆盖整个星座的擢升归属。失势与入庙星座相对，落陷与擢升星座相对。essential_dignities 按入庙、擢升、失势、落陷顺序返回全部命中；空元组表示这四项均未命中。HouseRulers 对给定的每个宫头星座调用 sign_ruler，并保留已有的宫主星落点，不重新计算；这一组合政策由项目定义。

tradition.en: William Lilly, Christian Astrology (London, 1647), Book I, chapters VIII–XIV and XVIII. Lilly labels his table according to Ptolomy; Ptolemy's original text was not inspected.
tradition.zh: William Lilly 的 Christian Astrology（伦敦，1647），第一卷第 VIII–XIV 章及第 XVIII 章。Lilly 称其表依据 Ptolomy；此处未核 Ptolemy 原文。

limits.en: Only these four statuses for the seven classical planets. No exact-degree assessment, sect condition, node dignities, outer-planet rulers, triplicity, terms, faces, reception or scores. Having none of these four does not establish peregrine status. Chart composition reads actual cusps, not axes, preserves the selected system and leaves uncalculated ruler placements absent.
limits.zh: 仅判断七政的这四种状态。不判断精确度数、昼夜条件、交点尊贵、外行星守护、三分性、界、面、互容或总分。四项均未命中不等于游离。命盘组合读取实际宫头，不以轴代替，保留所选宫制，并将未计算的宫主星落点保留为缺失。

definition.en: astrology.zodiac.element_of assigns one Element to each Sign. Equal-count statistics give each explicitly supplied object one count, divided by the selected population size.
definition.zh: astrology.zodiac.element_of 将每个 Sign 归入一个 Element。等权统计对每个显式提供的对象计一次，以所选对象总数为分母。

tradition.en: Modern classification as listed by Astrodienst, The four Elements and the Signs.
tradition.zh: Astrodienst 的 The four Elements and the Signs 所列的现代分类。

limits.en: No personality interpretation or object-importance weighting. Equal counts and nonempty population selection are project policies.
limits.zh: 不作性格解读或对象重要性加权。等权计数及选择非空对象集合是项目政策。

definition.en: astrology.zodiac.modality_of assigns one Modality to each Sign. Statistics use the same explicit equal-count population as the element summary.
definition.zh: astrology.zodiac.modality_of 将每个 Sign 归入一个 Modality。统计与元素摘要使用同一个显式选定的等权对象集合。

tradition.en: Astrodienst's cardinal, fixed and mutable (or common) qualities.
tradition.zh: Astrodienst 所列的 cardinal、fixed、mutable（或 common）三种性质。

limits.en: Ashmand's fixed and bicorporeal sets agree with modern fixed and mutable; its tropical and equinoctial pairs together form the cardinal set. Membership agreement does not merge identities or traditions.
limits.zh: Ashmand 的固定及双体集合分别与现代固定及变动集合相同；至点与分点两对合起来构成基本模式集合。成员相同不合并身份或传统。

definition.en: astrology.lunar_phase.lunar_phase classifies the oriented Moon-minus-Sun longitude difference using the eight consecutive intervals in its executable definition. The project uses half-open intervals, assigning exact endpoints to the following type; 0/180 degrees are angular turning points, strict (0, 180) is waxing and strict (180, 360) waning.
definition.zh: astrology.lunar_phase.lunar_phase 按可执行定义中的八个连续区间，对有向的月减日黄经差分类。项目采用半开区间，精确端点归后型；0／180 度为角度转折点，严格 (0, 180) 为盈，严格 (180, 360) 为亏。

tradition.en: Dane Rudhyar, Your Lunation Birthday, Part Four, online archival transcription reporting first publication in January 1950. Endpoints and direction labels are project policies.
tradition.zh: Dane Rudhyar 的 Your Lunation Birthday 第四部分在线档案转录，页面自述初刊于 1950 年 1 月。端点及方向标签是项目政策。

limits.en: Inputs must share an instant and coordinate convention. Categories cover ranges, not exact events. No illuminated fraction, 3D phase angle, event search, personality or biological interpretation.
limits.zh: 输入须采用同一时刻及坐标约定。类别覆盖区间，不表示精确事件。不计算照亮比例、三维相角或事件搜索，也不作性格或生理解读。

definition.en: The chart adapter selects celestial-calendar's WHOLE_SIGN geometry explicitly, then assigns longitudes to its supplied cusps using rule.project.cusp_ownership. The Ascendant need not coincide with the first cusp.
definition.zh: 排盘适配层显式选择 celestial-calendar 的 WHOLE_SIGN 几何，再按 rule.project.cusp_ownership 将黄经归入给定宫头所界定的宫。上升点不必与第一宫头重合。

tradition.en: Project binding to a named upstream house system, not an independent historical derivation.
tradition.zh: 项目对具名上游宫制的绑定，不是独立的历史推导。

limits.en: Requires the adapter's joint computation domain and defined axes. Selecting Whole Sign does not bypass upstream geometry restrictions or provide a fallback.
limits.zh: 须满足适配层的共同有效域，且四轴有定义。选择整宫制不会绕过上游几何限制，也不提供替代策略。

definition.en: The chart adapter selects celestial-calendar's EQUAL geometry explicitly, then assigns longitudes to its supplied cusps using rule.project.cusp_ownership.
definition.zh: 排盘适配层显式选择 celestial-calendar 的 EQUAL 几何，再按 rule.project.cusp_ownership 将黄经归入给定宫头所界定的宫。

tradition.en: Project binding to a named upstream house system, not an independent historical derivation.
tradition.zh: 项目对具名上游宫制的绑定，不是独立的历史推导。

limits.en: Requires the adapter's joint computation domain and defined axes. Equal houses do not replace an unavailable requested system.
limits.zh: 须满足适配层的共同有效域，且四轴有定义。所请求宫制不可用时，不会改用等宫制。

definition.en: The chart adapter selects celestial-calendar's PLACIDUS geometry explicitly, then assigns longitudes to its supplied cusps using rule.project.cusp_ownership. An unavailable geometry fails the chart request.
definition.zh: 排盘适配层显式选择 celestial-calendar 的 PLACIDUS 几何，再按 rule.project.cusp_ownership 将黄经归入给定宫头所界定的宫。几何不可用时，排盘请求失败。

tradition.en: Project binding to a named upstream house system, not an independent historical derivation.
tradition.zh: 项目对具名上游宫制的绑定，不是独立的历史推导。

limits.en: Requires the adapter's joint computation domain and a defined Placidus geometry. Failure returns neither a partial chart nor another house system.
limits.zh: 须满足适配层的共同有效域，且普拉西德几何有定义。失败时既不返回部分命盘，也不换用另一宫制。

definition.en: The adapter maps the MEAN node definition to the upstream mean ascending and descending targets. The direction stays on each LunarNode identity; the five-term correction is not selected for this definition.
definition.zh: 适配层将 MEAN 交点定义对应到上游的平升交点和平降交点。方向由各 LunarNode 身份保留；此定义不选用五项修正。

tradition.en: Project definition binding, not an accuracy setting.
tradition.zh: 项目定义绑定，不是精度档位。

limits.en: The project test calculates a mean-node value from its reference formula, adds nutation and compares it with the upstream result. It does not verify the printed Meeus text, establish an error bound or make this interchangeable with a true or osculating node.
limits.zh: 项目测试按参考公式计算平交点，加上章动项，再与上游结果比较。这不表示已核验 Meeus 印刷原文或确立误差界，也不表示它可与真交点或密切轨道交点互换。

definition.en: The adapter maps MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE to the upstream true ascending and descending targets. The project identifies the series by comparing the result with the mean node plus five sine corrections and nutation; the upstream target name itself does not specify that series.
definition.zh: 适配层将 MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE 对应到上游的真升交点和真降交点。项目以平交点加五项正弦修正及章动项对照结果，据此认定级数；上游目标名称本身未指明该级数。

definition.en: The tropical zodiac divides ecliptic longitude into twelve half-open 30-degree sectors; a longitude exactly on a sector boundary belongs to the higher sign.
definition.zh: 热带黄道把黄经分为十二个半开的 30 度区间；恰好落在区间边界上的黄经归入后一个星座。

tradition.en: Project convention for the tropical zodiac; it is not a claim about the constellations or about historical sign division.
tradition.zh: 热带黄道的项目约定；不表示关于天文星座或历史星座划分的断言。

limits.en: Applies to tropical longitudes only; the sidereal zodiac is not implemented. Historical grouping over Sign values is separate in rule.ptolemy_ashmand.sign_groups.
limits.zh: 只适用于热带黄经；恒星黄道未实现。基于 Sign 值的历史分组另见 rule.ptolemy_ashmand.sign_groups。

definition.en: House membership uses half-open intervals [cusp, next cusp): a longitude exactly on a cusp belongs to the house that starts there, and membership wraps across 0/360 degrees.
definition.zh: 落宫使用半开区间 [宫头, 下一宫头)：恰好落在宫头上的黄经归入从该宫头开始的宫，成员关系跨 0/360 环绕。

tradition.en: Project convention for two-dimensional house placement; the house systems themselves are named requests.
tradition.zh: 二维落宫的项目约定；宫制本身是具名请求。

limits.en: Uses the supplied cusp geometry only. Whether an axis coincides with a cusp is a property of the requested house system.
limits.zh: 只使用给定的宫头几何。四轴是否与宫头重合是所请求宫制的性质。

name.zh: Ashmand 所译托勒密的分点星座

definition.en: This edition calls Aries and Libra equinoctial signs, with the rationale preserved in the cited sentence.
definition.zh: 此版本称白羊座与天秤座为分点星座，所引整句保留其解释理由。

tradition.en: Ptolemy through the paraphrase attributed to Proclus, Ashmand's 1822 English translation; single-source historical record.
tradition.zh: 托勒密经被归于 Proclus 的转述本，由 Ashmand 于 1822 年译为英文；单源历史记录。

limits.en: This record preserves the historical sentence; executable membership is in rule.ptolemy_ashmand.sign_groups. The equal-day/night explanation is not a guarantee about observed daylight and supplies no house system or chart interpretation.
limits.zh: 此记录保留历史原句；可执行成员归属见 rule.ptolemy_ashmand.sign_groups。昼夜等长的解释不保证实际日照时长，也不提供宫制或命盘解读。

definition.en: astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group maps each Sign to one AshmandSignGroup. The source explicitly names the tropical and equinoctial pairs; fixed signs immediately follow those signs in zodiac order, and bicorporeal signs immediately follow the fixed signs. The reference table reads that executable definition.
definition.zh: astrology.zodiac.ashmand_sign_group 将每个 Sign 归入一个 AshmandSignGroup。原文直接点名至点与分点两对星座；固定星座在黄道次序中分别紧接这些星座，双体星座分别紧接固定星座。参考表读取这一可执行定义。

tradition.en: Ptolemy through the paraphrase attributed to Proclus, Ashmand's 1822 English translation; one historical source, not a consensus across traditions.
tradition.zh: 托勒密经被归于 Proclus 的转述本，由 Ashmand 于 1822 年译为英文；这是一个历史来源，不是跨流派共识。

limits.en: The expanded twelve-sign table is project-derived, not a verbatim list. Tropical denotes only the solstitial group here. No physical-season guarantee, chart matching, score or interpretation is supplied.
limits.zh: 展开后的十二星座表由项目推导，不是原文逐项列举。此处 tropical 只指至点分组。不提供实际季节保证、命盘匹配、评分或解读。

definition.en: The oriented separation runs from the first object to the second, in (-180, 180] degrees of ecliptic longitude. An aspect with exact angle theta holds when the separation differs from a branch by at most the limit, the limit included. The branches are minus and plus theta for a sextile, square or trine, and the single angle 0 or 180 for a conjunction or opposition. Every holding branch is reported, in the order of the objects, then the aspect angle, then the minus branch before the plus branch.
definition.zh: 有向间距从第一个对象指向第二个，是黄经上取值在 (-180, 180] 度内的差。精确角度为 θ 的相位，在间距与某个分支的差不超过限度时成立，限度本身包含在内。六分、四分、三分相的分支是 −θ 和 +θ，合相与对分相只有 0 或 180 这一个角度。凡成立的分支都会报告，顺序是先按对象，再按相位角，同一相位里负分支在正分支之前。

tradition.en: Project convention; it is not attributed to a tradition.
tradition.zh: 项目约定，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Ecliptic longitude only. Latitude, declination, minor aspects, whole-sign aspects and aspects to axes are not evaluated.
limits.zh: 仅限黄经。黄纬、赤纬、次要相位、整宫相位及与轴线的相位都不判断。

definition.en: For positions and rates at one shared instant, the relative longitude rate is the second object's rate minus the first's. Away from a deviation of 180 degrees, opposite signs of the relative rate and deviation mean applying; matching signs mean separating. Zero deviation is exact. Zero relative rate with nonzero deviation is stationary: the objects have no relative motion, but either planet may still be changing longitude. A missing rate is indeterminate. At a deviation of 180 degrees with nonzero relative motion, the absolute wrapped deviation has no two-sided derivative and the status is indeterminate. Floats are compared directly, without a tolerance.
definition.zh: 对同一时刻的位置和速率，相对黄经速率是第二个对象的速率减去第一个的速率。偏差不为 180 度时，相对速率与偏差异号表示入相，同号表示离相。偏差恰为零表示精确；相对速率恰为零且偏差不为零表示静止，意思是两个对象没有相对运动，不表示某颗行星的黄经速率为零。缺少速率时为不确定。偏差恰为 180 度且存在相对运动时，回绕后的绝对偏差没有双侧导数，状态为不确定。直接比较浮点数，不使用容差。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Describes this instant only. It does not predict whether an aspect will become exact; either object may change direction before that happens.
limits.zh: 只描述当前时刻，不预测相位之后会不会变得精确；任一对象都可能在达到精确相位前改变运动方向。

name.en: Objects that take part in aspects

definition.en: In single-chart evaluation, aspects are judged among the requested objects, or among a chosen subset of them. Two lunar nodes never form an aspect with each other: the four node identities are one pair of nodes under two definitions and two directions. A node may form an aspect with a body. Axes are not objects of a chart request and take no part.
definition.zh: 在单盘判断中，相位在已请求的对象之间判断，或在其中选出的子集之间判断。两个月交点之间不构成相位：四个交点标识只是同一对交点的两种定义和两个方向。月交点可以与天体构成相位。轴线不是排盘请求里的对象，不参与。

tradition.en: Project convention; it is not attributed to a tradition.
tradition.zh: 项目约定，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: The exclusion of aspects between nodes in single-chart evaluation is a project convention. A convention that draws no aspects for a node at all is expressed by leaving the node out of the chosen subset.
limits.zh: 单盘判断中不判月交点之间的相位，是项目约定。某个惯例若根本不为月交点画相位，就把它排除在所选子集之外。

name.zh: 任一对象自己的容许度

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within at least one object's orb, so the limit is the larger of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差在至少一个对象的容许度内就算符合，因此上限取两个容许度中较大的值。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

name.zh: 两个对象各自的容许度

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within both objects' orbs, so the limit is the smaller of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差必须在两个对象各自的容许度内才算符合，因此上限取两个容许度中较小的值。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within the mean of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差不超过两个容许度的平均值就算符合。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

name.zh: 静态双盘交叉相位判断

definition.en: Pair each selected left position with each selected right position, preserving both source charts. An omitted selection means all positions on that side, independently of natal participants. Same-named objects and all named node-node pairs are allowed, including the same chart in both roles. Use caller-supplied aspect rules and identity-keyed object orbs, never either chart's natal rules. Retain every matching oriented branch, signed deviation and inclusive orb limit; no motion status is assigned.
definition.zh: 将每个所选左位置与每个所选右位置配对，保留双侧源盘。省略选择表示该侧全部位置，不继承本命参与者。允许同名对象及所有具名交点之间的配对，也允许同一张盘占两个角色。使用调用方给出的相位规则及按对象标识设置的容许度，不继承任一盘的本命规则。保留每个匹配的有向分支、带符号偏差及包含等号的容许度上限，不赋予运动状态。

tradition.en: Project geometry policy; no tradition or interpretation is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目几何政策，不归于某个传统，也不提供解读。

limits.en: Compare matching tropical/geocentric own-date position conventions directly, without common-epoch conversion or a simultaneous spatial-angle claim. Rates at different birth instants do not establish shared evolution. No default orb, interpretation, house overlay or composite construction is supplied.
limits.zh: 在热带地心自身日期的位置坐标约定相同时直接比较，不转换共同历元，也不声称是同时刻的空间角。不同出生时刻的速率不能确立共同演化。不提供默认容许度、解读、宫位叠加或组合盘构造。

statement.zh: 具名 Lilly 1647 年版规则给出星座守护星，并保留每个适用的入庙、擢升、失势及落陷状态。表格由项目按已核章节归属及相对星座定义展开，不是逐格引用印刷表。Lilly 在这些段落所说的行星 houses 指入庙星座，不是命盘编号宫位。

prerequisites.en: Supply an exact Sign and, for status assessment, a supported Body. HouseRulers requires a supplied NatalChart; existing placements are reused and absent ruler placements remain absent.
prerequisites.zh: 提供确切的 Sign 枚举；判断状态时另需受支持的 Body。HouseRulers 要求给定 NatalChart，复用已有落点，将未计算的宫主星落点保留为缺失。

exceptions.en: Wrong types and unsupported outer planets are rejected explicitly; supported no-match is an empty tuple. An uncalculated ruler placement is None, not no-match. Four-status emptiness is not a peregrine judgment.
exceptions.zh: 错误类型及未支持的外行星明确报错；支持对象无命中时返回空元组。宫主星落点未计算时为 None，不表示无命中。四项为空不构成游离判断。

limits.en: One named historical set. No reception, aggregate strength, modern rulership or interpretation. The source's day/night house labels and other dignities are not conditions on these four queries. Catalog retrieval never evaluates chart applicability.
limits.zh: 仅限一个具名历史规则集。不提供互容、综合强度、现代守护或解读。原文的昼夜庙标签及其他尊贵不是这四项查询的附加条件。目录检索从不判断命盘适用性。
